A card is drawn at random from a pack of 52 cards.

Calculate the probability that the card drawn is

questions.corrige_markdown:
A pack of 52 cards contains 4 Aces (one in each suit).

$P(\text{Ace})=\dfrac{4}{52}=\dfrac{1}{13}$

**Answer: $\dfrac{1}{13}$** (about $0.077$).

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) a Spade *[4 marks for the whole question]*

A pack of 52 cards contains 13 Spades.

$P(\text{Spade})=\dfrac{13}{52}=\dfrac{1}{4}$

**Answer: $\dfrac{1}{4}$** ($0.25$).
